category_name: This image captures a central bronze statue of a man holding an umbrella. The statue stands on a red brick floor laid in a herringbone pattern. The bronze statue of a man is dressed in a red tie. He holds a large, open black umbrella. A glass and metal canopy provides partial coverage over the area. Nearby are small circular metal tables accompanied by several matching black metal chairs. Further back, a person with a backpack sits, while another person and a white car are visible in the distance.
